svg.aria-label: A grid of 13 models against 10 countries showing what a month of moderate use costs as a share of monthly GNI per capita. The cheapest model on the grid costs 4.6% of monthly GNI per capita and the dearest 268%, so affordability turns on which model a user picks, not only on where they live.
svg.text: A month of moderate use, as a share of monthly GNI per capita
Ten-country heatmap: 20 x the standard workload (1M input + 250k output tokens), against Atlas-method GNI per capita
divided by 12. The wider country comparison is in profiles and the CSV.
Cells show the share of monthly GNI per capita; a value above 100% means a month of use costs more than a month of average GNI per capita.
Data: the Observatory record · CC BY 4.0 · compiled 2026-09-30 · income base is the Atlas method, which smooths exchange rates
